pages.text: Vein-Mining Pickaxes combine area mining with vein mining capabilities. These improved tools have much higher durability than their standard counterparts.

pages.title: Vein Mining
pages.text: When breaking an ore block, all connected blocks of the same ore type are automatically mined in a chain reaction, up to a maximum of 128 blocks.

pages.title: Grade Progression
pages.text:
$(bold)Grade 2$(): Iron/Diamond Improved - 3x3x3 cubic OR 3x3x1 flat + vein mining
$(bold)Grade 4$(): Iron/Diamond Improved - 5x5x5 cubic OR 5x5x1 flat + vein mining

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
$(bold)Left-click$(): Area mine + vein mining (when not sneaking)
$(bold)Shift + Left-click$(): Single block mining
$(bold)Right-click$(): Toggle between cubic and flat mode

pages.title: Materials & Durability
pages.text:
Improved Iron: 3750 durability (3x standard)
Improved Diamond: 23415 durability (3x standard)
